summary: Monolithic infrastructure-as-code repo for a Raspberry Pi home lab plus multi-cloud (GCP/OCI/Cloudflare). Terragrunt-wrapped Terraform provisions cloud, Ansible bootstraps systems, FluxCD reconciles TWO k3s clusters: 'firefly' (Pi + OCI nodes) and 'franklinhouse' (6 VMs on a 3-node Proxmox cluster, folded in from calebsargeant/infra-v2 on 2026-08-13).

terraform-cloudflare.purpose: DNS records (sargeant.co, magmamoose) and Zero Trust tunnels/applications

terraform-fortigate.purpose: Two standalone home-lab FortiGate 40Fs (no HA), dual-ISP resilient edge. fortios provider iterated per-unit via for_each (OpenTofu 1.9+). Self-contained leaf (no root.hcl include). VLAN segmentation (trusted/iot/guest/mgmt) over an 802.1Q trunk to the MikroTik; per-VLAN DHCP + segmentation policies. Both ISPs active-active. BGP-routed IPsec site-to-site VPN to OCI (vpn.tf/bgp.tf, OCI side oci/.../vpn-fortigate) with SD-WAN steering (sdwan.tf); BGP scope OCI+FGT-FGT. IPsec dial-up remote access via Google SAML (remote-access.tf). Syslog/NetFlow + automation stitches (monitoring.tf). Base-license only.
terraform-fortigate.notes: Hardware not wired yet — Atlantis autoplan disabled (enabled:false); run 'atlantis plan -p fortigate-prod' once units are reachable + API tokens are in OCI Vault. Placeholder RFC1918 addressing; verify 40F physical port names before apply.

terraform-mikrotik.purpose: Two physical home-lab MikroTik CRS edge switches (one behind each FortiGate). routeros provider iterated per-unit via for_each (OpenTofu 1.9+). L2 access bridge (MSTP, shared region) + routed /30 cross-link & inter-switch uplinks. Both ISPs active-active via ECMP (equal-distance default routes), no failover. Pairs with terraform/fortigate. NOT the OCI CHRs under terraform/oci/.../mikrotik.
terraform-mikrotik.notes: Hardware not wired yet (mt2 not installed) — Atlantis autoplan disabled; run 'atlantis plan -p mikrotik-prod' once reachable + password in OCI Vault. Placeholder addressing consistent with terraform/fortigate; verify CRS port names before apply.

terraform-gcp.purpose: GCP project setup (state bucket, IAM); state lives in GCS magmamoose-terraform project

terraform-oci.purpose: OCI infra across TWO tenancies sharing one module set: 'caleb' (firefly, prod/eu-amsterdam-1 + tenancy-root IAM) and 'traceysargeant' (cloudworkers/, added 2026-08-31 for its own Always Free allowance). Covers network, edge, server, mikrotik, vpn, database, backups, drg-peering, policy.
terraform-oci.notes: OCI Vault publicly accessible (KMS endpoints are public-internet + OCI-auth, not VPN-gated). modules/server provisions the ff-oci1/ff-oci2 arm64 free-tier k3s agents (native-cloud tier): servers map takes node_name + node_labels; cloud-init joins via token from Vault. Editing the module needs manual 'atlantis plan -p oci-prod-eu-amsterdam-1-server'
terraform-oci.multi_tenancy: Credentials are chosen by an 'env_prefix' local in the NEAREST provider.hcl, resolved by find_in_parent_folders and read by terraform/root.hcl (try(..., "OCI")) to build <PREFIX>_{TENANCY_OCID,USER_OCID,FINGERPRINT,PRIVATE_KEY_PATH}. terraform/oci/provider.hcl = "OCI" (firefly, unchanged); terraform/oci/cloudworkers/provider.hcl = "OCI_CW" and shadows it for everything below. It only feeds the GENERATED provider, so each cloudworkers leaf ALSO asserts tenancy_ocid/compartment_ocid with HCL regex() at parse time: an unset var would silently fall back to firefly's ~/.oci/config DEFAULT profile and build in the wrong tenancy. Keep the groups non-capturing.
terraform-oci.cloudworkers_notes: Second tenancy 'traceysargeant', eu-amsterdam-1, VCN 192.168.240.0/24: ff-chr3 .11 / ff-chr4 .12 (edge), ff-oci3 .71 / ff-oci4 .72 (native-cloud k3s agents joining firefly). Autoplan is DISABLED on all four projects in atlantis.yaml (Atlantis holds firefly's OCI creds only, no OCI_CW_*), so run 'atlantis plan -p oci-cloudworkers-prod-eu-amsterdam-1-{network,edge,vpn,server}' by hand or terragrunt locally. Cold-start apply order: network (internet_gateway_ip = "") -> edge -> network again with 192.168.240.11 -> vpn -> server. Operator prerequisites: import a CHR image into the tenancy (custom images do not cross a tenancy boundary) and put a COPY of the k3s node-token in vault-cloudworkers. See .claude/decisions/2026-08-31-second-oci-tenancy-cloudworkers.md

kubernetes-apps.purpose: Per-app manifests. Each app has base/<app>/ (kustomize manifests) + prod/<app>/ (Flux Kustomization CR). NOTE: every app in kubernetes/apps/kustomization.yaml is firefly's. access-control is franklinhouse-only and absent from that aggregator; github-runner has a separate franklinhouse-prod/ sibling that franklinhouse references directly.

kubernetes-infrastructure.purpose: Cluster-wide tiers, deployed in order via Flux Kustomizations with dependsOn

tiers.services: infrastructure-services — cloudflared, minio, external-dns×2, postgres, postgres-oci (CNPG pinned to the OCI native-cloud tier, ns database-oci), mariadb (dependsOn controllers)

kubernetes-components.notes: resource-profiles map AWS-style names (t.small, c.medium, m.large) to Pi-constrained requests/limits. node-selectors: system/worker (+ legacy pi/mini) and native-cloud (topology.sargeant.co/tier=native-cloud, the OCI ff-oci tier)

kubernetes-clusters.purpose: Flux bootstrap entries, one per cluster. firefly's root pulls in ../../apps + ../../infrastructure (shared trees). franklinhouse's root pulls in ../../apps/access-control + ../../apps/github-runner/franklinhouse-prod plus its own cluster-local ./infrastructure (own CNPG operator + Postgres Clusters) and ./system (Traefik config) — aggregating ../../apps there would deploy all of firefly onto franklinhouse. See docs/reference/franklinhouse.md

ansible.purpose: System bootstrap, config management, docker host setup, network device config

playbook_prefixes.docker-*: Docker host deployments; suffix indicates target host (-firefly, -server, -raspberry, -whale, -dockervm)

ansible.roles: ansible/roles/ — 35+ idempotent roles (k3s-fluxcd-bootstrap, k3s-sops-age-secret, mikrotik-dns, postgres-config, etc.)

dockerfiles.purpose: Custom container images built from this repo

scripts.purpose: Ad-hoc utility scripts; Linux/ and Windows/ subdirs; tooling for AWS SSO, OCI inspection, auto-shutdown, terraform imports

docs.purpose: MkDocs source for https://calebsargeant.github.io/infra/ — getting-started, guides, operations, reference (helm-charts, terraform-modules)

terraform-aws.purpose: AWS serverless front doors and shared artifact buckets, per product. Free-tier-shaped: Lambda + SQS FIFO + DynamoDB + EventBridge Scheduler, no NAT and no CMKs.
terraform-aws.structure: Each product with its own AWS account has its own subtree (<product>/provider.hcl + <product>/prod/<region>/<leaf>/) so credentials are isolated. Products sharing the default account live under prod/<region>/. localstack/ provides a local Docker-based AWS sandbox (docker-compose + main.tf + seed.sh + smoke.py) for integration testing.
product_trees: prod/ (nievah-frontdoor, caldrith-frontdoor, caldrith-artifacts, cost-report, artifacts — default account)
terraform-aws.notes: brimyr-broker reuses the chargate-broker module (parameterised on oidc_audience). localstack/ is NOT a Terragrunt leaf — run 'docker compose up -d' then 'terraform apply' inside it for local smoke tests.

callgraph_highlights.note: Flux root — owns the full reconciled state
Each app's Flux Kustomization CR points its path: at base manifests
Terragrunt leaves source modules + inherit root config; backend.tf and provider.tf are auto-generated
Preferred runtime secret path; SOPS is fallback only

Atlantis is legacy; covers 24 of 33 leaves, and autoplan is off on 7 of those 24 (fortigate, mikrotik, vpn-fortigate, and all 4 oci-cloudworkers-* projects, which need OCI_CW_* credentials Atlantis does not hold). The gate is .github/workflows/terragrunt.yml, which discovers every leaf from the filesystem (all 9 AWS leaves included) and replans all of them when a shared input changes. Terrateam is workflow_dispatch-only and has no .terrateam/config.yml here, so it plans nothing.

secret_management_priority: 3. SOPS + Age (last resort — .enc.yaml only, kustomization label app.kubernetes.io/sops=enabled)

path_notes.kubernetes/clusters/firefly/flux-system/: gotk-sync bootstrap pointing at this repo
path_notes.kubernetes/clusters/franklinhouse/kustom: Flux root for franklinhouse (loads ../../apps/access-control ONLY + cluster-local infrastructure)
path_notes.terraform/root.hcl: Terragrunt inheritance root, version pins, GCS backend
path_notes.atlantis.yaml: when adding a new Terragrunt leaf
path_notes.AGENTS.md: when introducing a new convention/pattern (definition-of-done requirement)
path_notes.terraform/oci/cloudworkers/prod/eu-amste: OCI infra changes in the SECOND tenancy (traceysargeant); needs OCI_CW_* env vars and a manual atlantis plan
path_notes.terraform/oci/cloudworkers/provider.hcl: when changing which tenancy the cloudworkers leaves authenticate as (env_prefix)
